hypothesis: Mapping loop indices k=0..n-2 to j=k+(k>=i) skips the target without a per-pair equality/continue branch. It preserves the order and arithmetic of every non-self interaction, while eliminating one loop iteration per output; whether this offsets the extra index calculation is for the controller to measure.
notes: This candidate changes only the source index traversal; it does not alter the force arithmetic or floating-point accumulation order. No speedup or correctness result is claimed before controller evaluation, including the official geometric-mean objective.
transformations: Replace the n-iteration loop and self-equality continue with n-1 iterations indexed by k; map each k around i using j=k+(k>=i). This visits the same non-self j values in the same order without changing interaction arithmetic.
